s.t:
Wir von Platri IT suchen Verstärkung im Bereich Product Ownership. Wir sind ein engagiertes und aufgeschlossenes Team mit Startup-Flair aus Bochum.
Neben der Entwicklung individueller Software in Form von Web-, App- und Plattformlösungen entwickeln wir eigene Softwareideen und begleiten digitale Produkte von der ersten Vision bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
Du studierst aktuell und möchtest nicht nur theoretisch lernen, wie digitale Produkte entstehen, sondern aktiv an echten Softwareprojekten mitarbeiten? Du hast Freude daran, Anforderungen zu verstehen, Nutzerbedürfnisse zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit Entwicklern und Designern aus Ideen funktionierende Software zu machen? Dann könnte Platri IT genau das Richtige für dich sein.
Warum Platri IT?
Jung & Trendy: Wir sind mehr als nur eine Agentur für Softwareentwicklung. Seit 2019 gestalten wir aktiv die digitale Welt, indem wir unsere Kunden unterstützen, bahnbrechende Web- und Mobileanwendungen zu kreieren.
User-First: Bei uns stehen die Kunden im Mittelpunkt. Ob Online-Portal, Business-App, E-Commerce-Lösung oder komplexe Webanwendung – wir bringen Technologie und Nutzererfahrung auf ein neues Level.
Startup Vibes: Werde Teil unserer Zentrale in Bochum und arbeite in einem Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für eigene Ideen. Tauche ein in die pulsierende Startup-Szene Deutschlands.
Vielfältige Projekte: Bei uns arbeitest du an spannenden Projekten aus unterschiedlichen Branchen – von Startups bis hin zu etablierten Unternehmen. Dabei lernst du verschiedene Geschäftsmodelle, Zielgruppen und technische Anforderungen kennen und bekommst einen echten Einblick in die Entwicklung individueller Softwarelösungen.
Aufgaben
Deine Mission?
Unterstütze unsere Product Owner bei der Planung und Steuerung individueller Softwareprojekte.
Lerne die Ziele, Geschäftsprozesse und Nutzergruppen unserer Kunden kennen.
Begleite interne Abstimmungen sowie Termine zur Entwicklung von Produktvisionen, Anforderungen und Konzepten.
Unterstütze bei der Übersetzung von Anforderungen in User Stories.
Hilf bei der Pflege, Strukturierung und Vorbereitung des Product Backlogs.
Bereite Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und weitere agile Termine mit vor.
Unterstütze dabei, Anforderungen eindeutig zu formulieren und offene Punkte nachzuhalten.
Hilf bei der Abnahme entwickelter Funktionen und unterstütze die Qualitätssicherung.
Dokumentiere Ergebnisse, Entscheidungen und Feedback aus Terminen.
Beobachte gemeinsam mit dem Team die Nutzung und Wirkung umgesetzter Funktionen und bringe eigene Verbesserungsideen ein.
Was macht diese Position besonders?
Echte Praxiserfahrung: Du unterstützt nicht nur im Hintergrund, sondern arbeitest aktiv an echten Softwareprojekten mit.
Einblick in Product Ownership: Du lernst, wie aus ersten Ideen konkrete Anforderungen, User Stories, Backlogs und digitale Produkte entstehen.
Direkter Impact: Deine Arbeit hilft dabei, Funktionen klarer zu definieren, Anforderungen besser zu strukturieren und Projekte erfolgreich voranzubringen.
Kundennähe: Du erhältst Einblicke in Abstimmungen, Workshops und Präsentationen und lernst, wie Kundenwünsche in eine klare Produktrichtung übersetzt werden.
Support & Learn: Fragen? Unser IT-Team steht dir stets zur Seite. Zudem garantieren wir dir ein individuell angepasstes Onboarding. Jeder Start soll einzigartig sein!
Raum für Ideen: Wir freuen uns über neue Perspektiven und geben dir die Möglichkeit, unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten.
Qualifikation
Du passt perfekt, wenn du …
…aktuell in einem passenden Studiengang eingeschrieben bist, z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, BWL, Medien, UX, Produktmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
…Interesse an digitalen Produkten, Softwareentwicklung und agilen Arbeitsweisen hast.
…komplexe Themen analysieren und verständlich strukturieren kannst.
…gerne mit Menschen kommunizierst und Lust auf die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Anwendern und technischen Teams hast.
…neugierig bist und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest.
…selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert arbeitest.
…erste Grundkenntnisse in agilen Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban mitbringst oder Lust hast, diese bei uns zu lernen.
…idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Tools wie Jira, Confluence oder Miro hast.
…Teamarbeit schätzt und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln möchtest.
…während des Semesters regelmäßig Zeit hast, unser Team zu unterstützen.

Hybrides Modell mit bis zu 50 % Remote-AnteilFlexible Arbeitszeiten, die zu deinem Studium passen
Individuell abgestimmtes Onboarding
Moderner Arbeitsplatz in BochumEquipment und moderne Hardware
Freigetränke

Kostenfreies Kursprogramm im Bereich Tanz und Meditation
Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
Persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung
Viel Raum für Eigeninitiative und neue Ideen
Ein echter Einblick in Product Ownership, Softwareentwicklung und digitale Produktarbeit
Bist du bereit, gemeinsam mit uns digitale Produkte zu entwickeln, die echte Probleme lösen?
Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Zur Verstärkung unserer wachsenden Produktorganisation suchen wir eine:n Product Owner.

Dein zukünftiger Aufgabenbereich könnte nah an der Customer Experience, dem kommerziellen und finanziellen Rückgrat oder dem technischen und datenbasierten Fundament unserer Plattform liegen – die optimale Passform definieren wir gemeinsam im Recruiting-Prozess. Übernimm die volle Verantwortung für deinen Produktbereich – von der Discovery über die Delivery bis hin zu messbaren Ergebnissen Verantworte und pflege das Product Backlog und priorisiere eigenständig auf Basis von Produktstrategie, Kundennutzen sowie Aufwand/Risiko Betreibe kontinuierliche Product Discovery: Sprich regelmäßig mit Kunden sowie Nutzern, validiere Probleme und Lösungen frühzeitig und teste Konzepte, bevor du sie skalierst Definiere und verfeinere Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Engineering Leads und Stakeholdern; übersetze komplexe geschäftliche, regulatorische oder technische Themen in klare Deliverables und messbare Ergebnisse Pflege und kommuniziere eine ergebnisorientierte Roadmap, die Innovation, Kundenbedürfnisse und Plattformstabilität in Einklang bringt Nutze Daten und Produktmetriken, um Entscheidungen zu treffen, Erfolge zu messen und zu iterieren – nicht nur für das Reporting Arbeite in unserer Product-Development-Organisation und liefere iterativ neue Funktionen, während du bestehende kontinuierlich verbesserst das bist du: Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager in einem SaaS-Umfeld.

Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe Backlogs zu managen und zwischen geschäftlichen, kundenbezogenen und technischen Anforderungen zu vermitteln. Praktische Erfahrung mit modernen Methoden der Produktentwicklung – Continuous Discovery, iterative Delivery, ergebnisorientiertes Roadmapping und evidenzbasierte Priorisierung.

Du definierst Erfolgsmetriken, arbeitest mit Produktanalysen und lässt dich bei deinen Entscheidungen von Fakten und Daten leiten. Du nutzt schon heute aktiv KI-Tools in deiner täglichen Arbeit und denkst darüber nach, wie KI sowohl Produkte als auch Prozesse verbessern kann. Du verstehst, wie moderne Softwareplattformen funktionieren (z. B.

APIs, Integrationen, Cloud-Architekturen), und kannst in Diskussionen mit Engineers auf Augenhöhe argumentieren. Exzellente Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten gegenüber technischem und nicht-technischem Publikum.

Du sprichst fließend Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus. das bieten wir: Remote First: Ob Homeoffice, deutschlandweite Coworking Spaces oder moderne Zentrale in Köln – wir decken alle Arbeitsformen ab. Gut ausgestattet: Damit es dir im Homeoffice an nichts fehlt, stellen wir die passende Hardware zur Verfügung.

Nach der Probezeit erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für ergonomisches Arbeiten von zu Hause. Flexibilität: Bei uns kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten: Mit einer Kernarbeitszeit von 9:00 bis 12:00 Uhr hast du Freiraum, um Beruf und Privatleben entspannt zu vereinen.

Mit unserem Workation Worldwide Programm kannst du bis zu 60 Arbeitstage im Jahr ortsunabhängig arbeiten – jetzt weltweit innerhalb von ±4 Stunden zur deutschen Zeitzone.

Benefits à la carte: Mit Probonio gestaltest du deine Benefits jeden Monat neu: Nutze dein Budget für Essenszuschüsse, Kita-Zuschüsse, Gutscheine oder buche dein Urban Sports Club Abo – ganz flexibel per App. Erholung & Auszeit : Du profitierst von 32 Tagen bezahltem Urlaub pro Jahr.

Zusätzlich sind Heiligabend und Silvester bei uns komplett arbeitsfrei. Mit unserem Culture Day kannst du dir außerdem einen Tag freinehmen, der dir persönlich wichtig ist – ganz bewusst und individuell.

Unternehmensweiter Bonus: Unser Shared Success Plan fördert den gemeinsamen Fokus auf unsere Ziele, indem wir den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens transparent und fair mit allen teilen. Mobilität & Nachhaltigkeit: Über FINN JobAuto kannst du dein eigenes E-Fahrzeug zu attraktiven Konditionen leasen. Zusätzlich profitierst du von Bikeleasing.

Teamgeist: Unsere Teams treffen sich einmal im Tertial persönlich zu Brainstorming, Workshops und natürlich zu unseren beliebten Sommer- und Winterfeiern. Gesund im Job: Wir unterstützen dich mit Urban Sports Club, Life Coaching Programmen und weiteren Angeboten, damit du fit und stressfrei durch den Arbeitsalltag kommst.

Dog-F riendly Headquarters : Dein vierbeiniger Freund ist im Büro herzlich willkommen -- bring deinen Hund einfach mit zur Arbeit!

Und noch mehr: 20 % Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Zugang zu unserem attraktiven Rabattportal und viel Spaß(!) - "Spark joy together" ist nicht umsonst eine unserer Firmenwerte. art der beschäftigung Vollzeit, 40 Stunden, unbefristet lust teil des teams zu werden? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Alle Menschen sind bei uns willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht / geschlechtlicher Identität, Behinderung / Beeinträchtigung, Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion / Weltanschauung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung. Hauptsache, du passt zu uns. Originally posted on Himalayas

Job Description: We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning.

We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role: The Product Manager, Applied Research Intelligence helps build Wiley ’s AI platform for life-sciences research and development — products that help scientists and R&D teams turn the world’s scientific literature and data into faster, better-evidenced decisions.

Working across the platform, you will partner with product, design, engineering, and data science to move features and improvements from idea to launch, and to keep what we build grounded in how researchers actually work.

You will contribute to product discovery with researchers and R&D users, help shape requirements and priorities, and track how your work performs once it ships. You’ll collaborate closely with senior product managers and the wider team across several workstreams, bringing the perspective of the life-sciences user to everyday product decisions.

This is a hands-on role with room to grow as the team and platform mature. Qualifications Product management experience (typically 5+ years) on B2B / enterprise software — ideally data, analytics, AI/ML, or platform products — contributing to products from discovery through launch.

Experience working in, or closely alongside, research and development in pharmaceutical or life-sciences organizations, with a good understanding of how scientists and research teams work. Ability to turn customer and market insight into clear requirements and measurable outcomes.

Comfort with technical concepts — data, APIs, and AI/LLM-driven workflows — and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and data science. Sound prioritization and judgment in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, drawing on both qualitative and quantitative evidence.

Strong communication and collaboration skills across internal product, design, engineering, and commercial teams as well as external integration partners. Experience contributing to a product or product line that scaled to $50M+ in revenue, from build through launch. Preferred Qualifications An advanced degree (PhD or MS) in a life-sciences field.

Familiarity with scientific informatics tooling (ELN/LIMS, Benchling-class tools), knowledge graphs, or systematic-review and evidence-synthesis workflows. We power infinite possibilities. For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world.

Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere. We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.

Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything. Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance. We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility.

Our values support courageous teammates, needle movers, and learning champions all while striving to support the health and well-being of all employees.

We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package.

People, and their well-being, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue. We partner closely with the best minds in healthcare — guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence — to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. Our ultimate goal? Move humanity forward by improving health for everyone.

Because at Solventum , we never stop solving for you. The impact you’ll make in this role As an Associate Product Manager, you’ll work alongside sharp, inquisitive minds from a wide spectrum of backgrounds and disciplines.

Together, you'll explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and shape solutions that make a real-world impact by: The RHT franchise is anchored by Restrata® Electrospun Fiber Matrix, a regenerative wound care solution designed to support soft tissue healing.

Restrata became part of Solventum ’s portfolio through the acquisition of Acera Surgical in December 2025.

The APM will execute product and program launch activities, including the development of launch materials, communications, and training programs, while gaining hands-on experience throughout the product development and commercialization process.

This role will also support the coordination of project deliverables across cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Sales, R&D, Clinical, and Regulatory stakeholders.

The successful candidate will bring strong business acumen, creativity, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while contributing to the successful development and launch of innovative wound care solutions.

Become a product expert in soft tissue healing and effectively articulate the features and benefits of Restrata to healthcare professionals and sales representatives.

Understand, manage, and develop programs for assigned surgical specialties, including the overall clinical landscape and strategic positioning of Solventum products within each specialty. Build, maintain, and support relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) in assigned specialties.

Develop and deliver training programs to educate customer-facing teams on product offerings, ensuring a deep understanding across the organization. Provide technical support for RHT products as needed. Regularly participate in surgeon visits, conferences, and trade shows to represent Solventum and gather voice-of-customer insights.

Collaborate with the graphic design team to develop product collateral, including case studies, brochures, website content, and videos. Partner with cross-functional teams on product specifications and market launches, contributing strategic insights to support business growth.

Conduct customer research through surveys, focus groups, and field visits to identify opportunities for product enhancements and innovation. Monitor market trends and the competitive landscape, providing actionable intelligence to support product development and market positioning.

Why Openly Openly is rebuilding insurance from the ground up. We are re-envisioning and enhancing every aspect of the customer experience.

Doing this requires a rapidly growing team of exceptional, curious, empathetic people with a wide range of skill sets, spanning technology, data science, product, marketing, sales, service, claims handling, finance, etc. The Openly Difference We created Openly because we saw an evident gap in the market for premium insurance made simple.

Consumers deserve more complete coverage at competitive prices. The Price Difference : Using cutting-edge data and technology, we provide you with customizable, competitive prices to protect your most valuable assets.

The Policy Difference: Coverages are truly customizable to meet your individual protection needs, for both standard coverages and optional add-ons. The Experience Difference: From tailored claims handling to highly responsive customer service, we are focused on making the home insurance purchasing process a better overall experience.

Welcome to your next adventure. At Openly , our people are just as important as our product. For us, collaboration, communication, and work-life balance are more than nice-to-haves— they’re the must-haves that make us who we are.

We believe a great company is the result of a shared set of values, so we look for these qualities in every candidate we hire. Integrity Empathy Teamwork Curiosity Urgency We've designed our hiring process with you, the candidate, in mind.

At every step, you have the chance to present your strengths and learn more about what makes Openly a great place to work. We're committed to Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion We embrace individuality and believe diverse teams are winning teams.

Our commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, religion, identity, and experience drives us forward every day. Job Details We are seeking a Regional Insurance Product Manager to own state-level strategy and market performance across an assigned region, and to help bring Openly insurance products to independent agents across the country.

Reporting to the Director of Insurance Product Management, this highly visible role offers the opportunity to lead key insurance product management initiatives and interact with business leaders across Technology and Operations Teams.

This role requires a self-motivated, high-energy individual who can efficiently function in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities Owning state-level strategy and calibrating Openly 's homeowners program for assigned states and new state entries, including UW eligibility, coverage offerings, competitive positioning, and Openly proprietary models Managing the state filing process and DOI relationships and correspondence, ensuring timely regulatory approval Collaborating with our Technology and Operations teams to successfully implement rate reviews and new state launches Monitoring and analyzing key performance indicators and drivers of profitability, including loss ratios, actuarial indications, frequency/severity trends, sales conversion, persistency, and translating findings into actionable strategic recommendations Developing cost-benefit analyses of state-level strategic initiatives and presenting recommendations that balance market opportunity with company objectives and profitability targets Identifying business challenges and opportunities, designing analytical frameworks to evaluate options, and delivering sound recommendations Cultivating partnerships with Business Development, serving as the primary conduit for field-level market feedback into the Insurance Product organization Escalating state-level insights that warrant countrywide product changes, acting as an internal advocate for market needs Contributing to other product management initiatives, such as external data evaluations, market/competitor intelligence, and new product development Requirements 3-5 years of experience in insurance product management or product development roles, with a demonstrated focus on strategy, analytics, or state-level product ownership A degree in Business Administration, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Economics, Statistics, or related field Solid analytical skills with the ability to develop and interpret quantitative analyses and translate findings into strategic narratives for senior business leaders and cross-functional audiences Demonstrated ability to identify and define complex business problems and develop relevant analytical frameworks to deliver solutions, often operating in ambiguity and leveraging creativity Strong communication, storytelling, and project management skills Able to collaborate effectively with people at all levels across the company Strong decision-making skills, using data to inform strategic recommendations P&C insurance experience is required, and homeowners insurance experience is a plus Insurance product compliance and/or state regulatory relationship experience is a plus Compensation Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

We build software to enable sustainable agriculture supply chains.

Enterprise software and new business processes can help - to make processes in the day-to-day more efficient, connect farmers better to their partners and thus, enable action in supply chains.

Today Root is the #1 primary data collection platform for dairy in DACH. We are AI-enabled at the core and driving the AI transformation across the food and agri world. The next chapter is bigger.

Build on top of Europe's #1 primary data collection platform and bring it to new heights - new markets, new commodities, ready for action. You will own our core product line end-to-end. Own the product line end-to-end. From discovery to delivery to ongoing maintenance. You decide what gets built, when, and why.

Prioritize across competing demands. Customer escalations, internal stakeholder asks, methodology updates, expansion bets. You will rarely have enough capacity for all of it. Make the calls that move the needle, communicate them clearly.
Go deep on methodology. Calculators, data sources, agricultural emission factors. The product is only as good as the science underneath. You will become one of the most knowledgeable people in Europe on how farm-level emissions get calculated.

The Problem Worth Solving
Generative AI is a powerful reasoning engine — but it operates blind inside enterprise software. It can't map a million-line multi-technologies codebase, trace cross-technology dependencies, or quantify technical debt. When asked to help modernize a legacy application, it guesses.
The industry's answer has been RAG and vector databases. Useful — but approximate. Semantic similarity is not the same as architectural truth.
CAST 's answer: give AI the exact structural blueprint of the application, derived deterministically from source code analysis across 150+ technologies. Not approximations. Actual call graphs, dependency maps, transaction flows — the ground truth of how software actually works. We call this Software Intelligence. We're now building the bridge that puts it directly in the hands of AI agents.

What You'll Be Building

As Technical Product Manager – AI & Agents, you'll own the product definition and roadmap for integrating CAST 's platforms — CAST Imaging and CAST Highlight — into the agentic AI ecosystem. Concretely:
MCP Server & Agentic integrations. CAST Imaging already exposes its structural insights via an MCP server, making any MCP-aware agent — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini — structurally aware of the application it's working on. You'll drive what data gets exposed, how agents consume it, and what new capabilities this unlocks for developers, architects, and transformation teams.
Hyperscaler partnerships . You'll manage and grow technical integrations with AWS and Google Cloud. Our published research with Google has already demonstrated that augmenting Gemini with CAST 's structural analysis produces measurably deeper results on enterprise codebases. You'll be the product owner turning that into a repeatable offering.
GSI co-innovation. Tier-1 global system integrators are at the forefront of industrializing AI in the software development lifecycle — at enterprise scale, across industries. You'll work directly with them to understand where AI-driven modernization breaks down in practice, what's missing, and where CAST intelligence fills the gap. They're one of your best proxies for real market needs, and a source of product ideas you won't find in analyst reports.
Next-generation retrieval. Our research team is actively exploring approaches that go beyond standard RAG — combining deterministic structural graphs with semantic retrieval to give agents richer, more grounded context. You'll translate emerging research into product bets, defining what gets productized and when.

Hands-on background in software engineering or architecture. You can read a call graph, understand what a dependency means in practice, and have opinions about technical debt.
Experience with agentic AI, LLM integrations, or developer tooling — building products or shipping integrations.
Ability to work across research, engineering, and commercial teams — and translate between all three.
Fluent English. Our teams and partners are global.

Why This Role The intersection of software intelligence and AI agents is where the next generation of enterprise software transformation will be decided. You'll work with a research team that publishes with Google Cloud, ships MCP integrations used by real enterprise customers, and is actively pushing the frontier on how AI understands software at scale. Get it right, and a utility bills accurately, at scale, with full auditability; get it wrong, and everything downstream breaks. This is an early-stage, build-it-from-the-ground-up role, and the meter is where you’ll start and not where you’ll stop.

Define how meter data is ingested and reconciled across interval and scalar sources.
Run VEE (validation, editing, estimation) and data-quality guardrails on the way into the core.
Assemble precise billing determinants (kWh, TOU-bucketed kWh, demand kW) for the tariff and billing engines.
Set the standard for how meter data flows through our unified model so that Gigawatt handles interval data and VEE natively in the core, not via a bolt-on MDM.

Own Meter: Drive the roadmap for meter data management end to end, from head-end ingest to billing determinants.

Ship Product: Define high-value MVPs, validate correctness against real reads, and iterate fast on edge cases and exceptions.

Engage SMEs Translate metering, MDM, and billing expertise into clear specs, enriched with AI-generated documentation and prototypes.

Wear many hats Do whatever it takes to move the platform forward, and take on new areas of ownership as priorities evolve.

MDM & metering: Strong knowledge of how MDM systems work ingest, interval/scalar data, data quality, VEE and how they feed a billing flow.

As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.
Your mission is to make Grafana Cloud the easiest and most trusted destination for OpenTelemetry workloads. You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.
Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes.

You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers.

This means treating agents are first-class participants in the experience and ensuring that instrumentation options, configuration requirements, errors, and validation signals are structured, discoverable, and actionable by both humans and machines.

OpenTelemetry SDK onboarding and configuration
Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection
Client-side OpenTelemetry Collector deployment and onboarding
Collector configuration, authentication, and initial connectivity
Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution
Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. You’ll partner closely with teams responsible for experiences such as Application Observability, Kubernetes Monitoring, Infrastructure Observability, and Drilldown Apps to ensure OpenTelemetry workloads receive a first-class experience from initial setup through first value.
This is a horizontal Staff-level product leadership role spanning multiple products and engineering teams. You may not directly own every SDK, collector, instrumentation technology, or downstream application involved in the journey. You will, however, be accountable for the coherence of the overall customer experience, its success measures, and the cross-product strategy required to improve it.
AI will also be part of how you work, not only what you build. You’ll be expected to use AI tools regularly to accelerate customer-research synthesis, analyze product signals, explore technical workflows, prototype experiences, develop positioning content, and test agent-led instrumentation journeys. You’ll model thoughtful, hands-on adoption of AI while applying strong judgement to its outputs.
The role is not focused on developing OpenTelemetry as an open source project in isolation. You’ll engage with and contribute to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem where appropriate, while measuring success through customer activation and outcomes in Grafana Cloud.

About Teramind
Teramind is a global leader in workforce intelligence, insider risk management, and data loss prevention. Used by thousands of companies across 60+ countries, our platform gives organizations the visibility to protect their people, their data, and their operations. We sit at the intersection of three converging markets - Insider Risk, DLP, and Workforce Analytics - and we are one of the few players that spans all three on a unified behavioral data layer.
The Teramind Endpoint Agent is one of the key differentiators of our platform. It runs on hundreds of thousands of endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux, capturing the behavioral signal that powers our detection, DLP enforcement, analytics, and AI. The depth and quality of what the Agent sees is a primary reason customers choose Teramind over the alternatives - and the product leader who owns it plays a pivotal role in the company's success.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Teramind Endpoint Agent, and the AI Usage Control capabilities built on top of it, end to end.

You will be the single accountable product leader for the roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of the Agent organization - approximately half of Teramind engineering, working across operating systems, low-level platform components, and the server-side telemetry pipeline. This is a pivotal role.

The Agent is one of the strongest competitive moats Teramind has, and the next chapter of the product strategy depends on what we build into it. You are coming in to bring product rigor, customer insight, prioritization discipline, and technical judgment to a team that is capable of shipping world-class endpoint technology.

AI Usage Control is one of the most important things you will build here. Companies have spent twenty years governing what employees do with sensitive data, and they now have a second workforce: AI agents reading files, calling tools, and executing commands on the same machines, with none of the accountability.

Nobody has worked out what supervising them looks like, and much of it never touches the network, so the endpoint is the only place you can see it. You will own that end to end. You will sit alongside other product managers, reporting to the VP of Product. Together, you own Teramind's product surface area.
What You Will Own
The Agent roadmap across all platforms. Windows, macOS, Linux, and the platforms after them. You decide what ships, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand, platform modernization, performance, and security hardening on one prioritized backlog.
The endpoint layer of AI Usage Control . Detecting AI that never touches the network - native desktop clients, IDE-embedded assistants, terminal-based coding agents, AI-native Teramind | Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint browsers, and local models running offline - and capturing the prompts, pastes, uploads, and agent-executed commands that browser and network DLP cannot see.
Translating business vision into engineering reality . You turn signals from executives, sales, customers, competitors and the engineering org into a coherent technical roadmap. You are the interpreter between “we need to detect AI exfiltration” and “here is how we instrument the endpoint to see it.”
Building for the enterprise: bulletproof and undetectable . Enterprise customers expect the Agent to be invisible to end users, resilient against tampering, and reliable in conditions that break weaker products. You own the roadmap that keeps it that way.
Performance, footprint, and reliability. Every CPU cycle, megabyte and battery percent we consume is felt by the end user and argued about by the customer's IT team. You set and defend the performance bar.
Define, measure, and meet product KPIs. Adoption, rollout velocity, deployment success rate, crash rates, detection coverage, time-to-patch on OS changes. You set the numbers and hold the team and the company to them.
Industry and ecosystem relationships. Microsoft, Apple, the Linux ecosystem, MDM vendors, and the major AV and EDR vendors. You represent Teramind in technical conversations where the agent's architecture is the subject.

5+ years of product management experience , with at least 3 owning a technical platform, SDK, agent, or systems-level product. This is a senior IC seat: influence without headcount.
Technical depth is non-negotiable . You do not need to write C++, but you should reason about Windows architecture, macOS system extensions, and the trade-offs between Endpoint Security and Network Extension frameworks. You can push back credibly in a design review.
You understand how AI actually runs on a computer . A hosted model in a browser tab, a native desktop client, an IDE-embedded assistant, a CLI coding agent, and a local model under Ollama are five different detection problems, and several are invisible to anything watching the network. You know why, and you know what an audit trail for an autonomous agent has to capture.
Endpoint or systems background. You have shipped endpoint security (EDR, EPP, XDR), monitoring or management agents, OS-level tools, or systems software. CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender, Tanium and similar are directly relevant. Pure SaaS and application PMs without systems exposure will struggle here.
You think in outcomes, not features. Success is “95% of customers roll out a new agent version within 30 days,” not “shipped version 27.0.”
You are comfortable with security trade-offs. Visibility versus privacy, tamper protection versus usability, cloud processing versus on-device intelligence. You can hold the attacker's perspective and the IT buyer's perspective in the same conversation.
You work with AI, not just about it. You use AI in your own practice, prototyping to pressure-test concepts before spending engineering cycles, and evaluating model behavior rather than trusting vendor claims.
You bring rigor, and you write. PRDs, decision memos, prioritization frameworks, release cadence, credible engineering-facing specs. In a distributed team, writing is how product management scales.

Endpoint agents are having a moment. Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default
Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we've built the world's largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar — tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives.
We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Check our open-source projects here .

We're building something new at Proton and we're hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front.
This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton's mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You'll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes.
We're looking for someone who has lived inside communities products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you've helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong and you want to do it in a way that doesn't exploit the people using it, this is the role.
What You'll Own
Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — from first principles through to shipped features — without waiting for direction from above
Own the metrics that matter: activation, engagement, retention, and community health. Set the targets, instrument the product to track them, and course-correct fast when signals shift
Translate deep knowledge of how online communities work — growth loops, moderation, network effects, content dynamics — into a clear product point of view and a prioritized execution plan
Lead cross-functional execution across a team of 6–12 engineers plus design, data, and growth — maintain velocity, surface blockers early, and keep the team focused on outcomes over activity
Drive structured discovery: user research, competitive analysis, and direct feedback loops that keep product decisions grounded in real behaviour, not assumptions
Represent the product externally when needed — to users, partners, and internal leadership — with clarity and confidence

10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on a social, messaging, or community platform
Deep understanding of community product mechanics — you can reason clearly about engagement loops, content moderation trade-offs, trust and safety, and network effects without needing it explained
Analytically sharp: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed calls without losing sight of user intuition
Strong, direct communicator — you write and speak with precision, push back when something doesn't make sense, and keep stakeholders aligned without over-meeting
Proven ability to lead a product autonomously: you identify the right problem, build the case, and drive it to shipped — without a roadmap handed to you

Experience building privacy-respecting alternatives to mainstream social or community platforms
Familiarity with open-source community protocols (atproto, IETF MLS, Matrix, etc.)
Background scaling a community product from early traction to millions of active users
Mainstream community platforms often optimize for attention, ads, and control. Proton has a different opportunity: to build community communication around privacy, user agency, and trust. This role is for a PM who understands the mechanics of social and community products, but wants to apply them in a way that respects the people using them.

Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments.
A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more.
Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work.
Learning & Development: We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one.
Employee Benefits: Strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support.
Stock Options: From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
In-Person Collaboration: Offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London, and more. You'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face.
Food: Lunch and snacks on us every day in the office.
Transport: We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking — whichever works for you.
Flexible Working: You own your schedule. Outcomes matter more than clock-in times.

adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

s.h: Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For
s.t:
Programmatic AdTech Domain Expertise: 3–4 years of Product Management experience (with at least 3 years directly in Programmatic, Ad Exchange, SSP, or DSP environments) to lead our DSP-facing ad exchange capabilities across their full lifecycle. Technical Infrastructure & API Fluency: Hands-on comfort working alongside senior engineers to parse system architecture, API designs, JSON data payloads, and latency tracking. Agile Product Delivery: Proven track record of owning end-to-end execution, experimentation, and scaling in an Agile environment. You manage multi-stakeholder dependencies cleanly and ship high-throughput features iteratively without sacrificing low-latency requirements.

Conduct product discovery to validate customer problems and determine where data can provide meaningful competitive advantage or business value.
Translate customer and market insights into clear product requirements, use cases, and product opportunities.
Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and evolving expectations for data, analytics, and intelligence products.
Establish ongoing customer feedback loops to inform product development and prioritization.

Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and discovery through development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
Translate business and customer needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
Work closely with data engineering, data science, analytics, software engineering, and technology teams to deliver scalable and reliable data products.

Identify opportunities to commercialize Reimagined Parking ’s data assets through new products, services, insights, APIs, reporting, analytics, and other data-enabled offerings.
Partner with commercial leadership to support product positioning, packaging, pricing, sales enablement, and go-to-market strategies.
Develop compelling product value propositions that clearly articulate the business outcomes customers can achieve.
Evaluate opportunities for new revenue streams and expansion within existing customer relationships.
Monitor product and market performance to identify opportunities for growth, product expansion, and improved customer value.
Data-Enabled Business Outcomes
Identify opportunities to use commercial data products and analytics to improve revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business decision-making.
Establish clear business outcomes and KPIs for data products and measure value delivered after launch.
Use product and customer data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and optimization.
Partner with internal business teams to ensure insights generated by data products are translated into actionable decisions and measurable outcomes.

Notre équipe Decathlon App recherche un·e Staff Product Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris.
Au cœur de l'écosystème digital de Decathlon, l'équipe Decathlon App fait le pont entre nos expériences e-commerce et le commerce physique. Notre mission dépasse la simple transaction : nous construisons un compagnon sportif quotidien, personnalisé et enrichi pour accompagner des millions d'utilisateur·ices dans leur pratique.

Rejoindre notre équipe produit globale (iOS & Android), c'est évoluer dans un environnement stimulant où l'autonomie, l'impact à grande échelle et l'excellence méthodologique sont au cœur de nos défis quotidiens.

En tant que Staff Product Manager (f/m/d), tu apporteras la vision stratégique et l'architecture fonctionnelle nécessaires pour faire passer notre application mobile à l'échelle supérieure. Tu opéreras avec une grande autonomie sur des enjeux complexes pour transformer l'expérience Decathlon App et garantir la cohérence de l'écosystème.
Tes responsabilités s'articulent autour de 4 piliers stratégiques :
Alignement stratégique, gestion des parties prenantes & vision app
Piloter la valeur globale ( macro view ) générée par les initiatives mobiles clés sur l'ensemble de l'écosystème business et client, au-delà des backlogs d'équipes individuelles.
Porter la vision produit auprès de la direction exécutive, des leaders business et des parties prenantes transversales pour aligner l'organisation sur la roadmap de l'application.
Définir les orientations stratégiques sur les segments utilisateurs prioritaires sur les points de contact mobiles natifs.
Suivre et optimiser les métriques de performance macro tout au long du funnel : notoriété, trafic, conversion, rétention et taux de réachat.
Architecture fonctionnelle & orchestration End-to-End
Agir en tant qu'Architecte Fonctionnel·le principal·e en définissant la répartition des périmètres entre les squads afin d'éliminer les frictions.
Travailler en triade étroite avec les Staff Tech/Principal Engineers et les Staff UX Designers pour aligner l'architecture technique, les systèmes de design et la vision produit.
Concevoir des parcours omnicanaux sans couture reliant la découverte mobile, les interactions en magasin (ex: Scan & Go, retrait), le paiement et les services sportifs.
Sparring stratégique & de-risking produit
Conseiller et accompagner les Group Product Managers (GPM) et Product Managers (PM) face aux dépendances complexes de l'application et aux pièges classiques du produit.
Structurer des stratégies de réduction des risques ( de-risking ) sur les projets majeurs pour identifier au plus tôt les enjeux d'appétence, de viabilité et d'utilisabilité.
Mener des boucles de validation concrètes (A/B testing, multivariés, tests d'utilisabilité de prototypes) pour valider les hypothèses avant le déploiement.
Élévation de la culture & des pratiques produit
Accompagner la communauté PM vers les meilleures pratiques produit modernes (frameworks de discovery, expérimentation continue, Opportunity Solution Trees - OST).
Promouvoir l'adoption des possibilités liées à l'IA et des méthodologies avancées pour enrichir l'expérience utilisateur et l'efficacité des squads.
Jouer un rôle de multiplicateur d'impact pour faire grandir la communauté Produit, sans agir en tant que manager hiérarchique.

Expérience Mobile Native : Solide parcours (7 ans+) en gestion de produits avec une expérience terrain dans la mise à l'échelle d'applications mobiles natives (iOS & Android) dans des environnements digitaux à fort volume.
Complexité E-commerce & Retail : Solide expérience dans l'e-commerce, les plateformes digitales ou le retail omnicanal où les produits digitaux se connectent directement aux points de contact opérationnels physiques.
Impact transversal : Expérience démontrée dans l'alignement inter-équipes et les initiatives architecturales au sein d'organisations produit multi-équipes.
Stratégie d'Application Native : Compréhension approfondie des paradigmes de design iOS/Android, des mécaniques des app stores, de l'analytics mobile et des stratégies d'engagement via push.
Discovery & Analytics : Expertise des méthodes de discovery quantitatives et qualitatives, de l'A/B testing, de l'optimisation de conversion (CRO) et des Opportunity Solution Trees (OST).
Architecture fonctionnelle : Capacité à structurer des problèmes business complexes en stratégies de MVP/V0/V1 claires.
Communication exécutive : Aisance pour traduire des architectures produit, des métriques UX et des données en présentations claires et convaincantes pour les dirigeants.
IA & Outils modernes : Curiosité et expérience pratique de l'intégration de l'IA dans les workflows produit et les expériences utilisateurs.

Influence stratégique et intelligence émotionnelle (leadership sans autorité hiérarchique).
Capacité à s'épanouir dans l'ambiguïté et à structurer des défis complexes.
Esprit de collaboration fort en Triade (Tech, Design, UXR, Data, Business).
Empathie et volonté de transmettre aux PM plus juniors.

s.t:

La posición de Product Manager se enmarca dentro del trabajo de gestión de productos tecnológicos. Te sumarás a un equipo ya constituido, trabajando en conjunto con otras disciplinas tales como Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineers, DevOps, Diseño (UX/UI) y equipos de negocio.
Trabajamos en diferentes proyectos que combinan volúmenes de datos enormes e IA, como detectar y predecir fallas antes que ocurran, optimizar pricing, personalizar la experiencia del cliente, optimizar uso de combustible y objetos usando visión por computador.
Tu trabajo como Product Manager será liderar la definición, priorización y evolución de productos basados en datos e IA, asegurando que resuelvan problemas reales de negocio y de usuario, generando valor medible y alineado con la estrategia de la compañía.

s.h: Como Product Manager tu trabajo consistirá en
s.t:
Ayudar a diseñar un plan de trabajo junto a los integrantes del equipo y establecer responsabilidades con metas claras y medibles.
Diseñar y co-liderar reuniones de gestión de desempeño para hacer seguimiento de los avances, identificando problemas que pongan en riesgo el progreso del proyecto y encontrando, junto al equipo, hipótesis de solución o mitigaciones.
Ser el principal gestor de la medición de impacto de los productos, estimando y relacionando el efecto de las acciones en los principales indicadores de la compañía (Ingreso, Costo, Experiencia de Cliente, Puntualidad, entre otros), utilizando técnicas experimentales y observacionales.
Gestionar, planificar y coordinar los proyectos y portafolios.
Dar seguimiento e informar los avances de la planificación realizada a las diferentes instancias involucradas.
Crear documentos y presentaciones que reflejen el avance del proyecto para los líderes de la organización y asegurar que los planes tácticos de trabajo estén alineados con la estrategia y visión de los líderes.
Experiencia trabajando con equipos de datos y de análisis en torno a indicadores de negocio.
Experiencia liderando el desarrollo de proyectos multidisciplinarios, enfocándose en cumplir las metas organizacionales internas, de los clientes y de liderazgo de equipos.
Experiencia apoyando en el desarrollo de negocios, preparación y liderazgo de propuestas, cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad internos y externos.
